intro: Armenian media highlight Prime Minister Pashinyan's diplomatic engagements in Ireland and upcoming travel to Cambodia, alongside continued coverage of border tensions with Azerbaijan and domestic economic developments.

topics.title: Pashinyan holds talks with Aliyev at European summit in Ireland
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan and Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev held talks on the margins of a European summit in Ireland. Pashinyan also discussed the peace process with Irish analysts and visited the Institute of International and European Affairs in Dublin. He is scheduled to make a short return to Armenia before traveling to Cambodia for the Francophonie summit.

topics.title: Azerbaijani soldier who crossed border faces completed investigation
topics.text: The investigation into the Azerbaijani serviceman who infiltrated an Armenian village and shot a woman has been completed. The victim has undergone a third surgery following the incident. Separately, a California superior court judge stated that Azerbaijan continues to commit crimes against Armenians, while Armenians detained in Baku reportedly lack legal solutions.

topics.title: European nations vow support for Armenia citing Russian pressure
topics.text: European nations have pledged continued support for Armenia's sovereignty and economic resilience, citing Russian pressure as a factor. The Core Group of Support to Armenia reaffirmed this commitment. Meanwhile, Azerbaijan declined to sign an anti-Russian declaration at the Dublin summit, and Russia's Federation Council outlined conditions for restoring Armenia's voting rights in the CSTO.

topics.title: ANCA welcomes hold on U.S. ambassador nominee to Azerbaijan
topics.text: The Armenian National Committee of America (ANCA) welcomed a move by Senator Tillis to block the confirmation of Alexander Alden as U.S. ambassador to Baku. ANCA also backed the hold on the confirmation of the U.S. envoy to Azerbaijan. These actions reflect ongoing diaspora advocacy efforts regarding U.S. policy in the region.

topics.title: Armenian chess players achieve strong results internationally
topics.text: Hayk Martirosyan defeated world champion Magnus Carlsen in a notable victory. Martirosyan also drew 1-1 with Anish Giri. Armenian youth players achieved outstanding results at the European youth championships, highlighting continued success in the sport.

topics.title: Constitutional Reform Council meets; Ladurée to open in Yerevan
topics.text: The Constitutional Reform Council held a regular meeting as part of ongoing domestic political processes. In economic news, the French luxury pâtisserie Ladurée announced plans to open in Yerevan. The Central Bank of Armenia also issued a silver collector coin dedicated to Sevanavank.

topics.title: Renowned choreographer Norayr Mehrabyan dies at 85
topics.text: Norayr Mehrabyan, founder of Armenia's Barekamutyun State Dance Ensemble, has died at the age of 85. The Second Khachaturian International Youth Competition concluded at the China National Opera House. A Sevanavank silver commemorative coin was unveiled as part of the "Historical Doors" series.
